added_lines: please note that the webcam will be in operation in the sanctuary area, and it’s surrounds of both churches within our parish. st kevin’s church keash vigil mass of the feast of all saints. saturday 31st 6.30pm christy mullen, late of dernaskeagh & london, (first anniversary). also, tommy killoran, battlefield and the deceased members of the killoran family. vigil mass of all souls day sunday 1st 6.30pm holy souls. saturday 7th 12 noon john boylan tullyboy (4th anniversary) and his brother séan boylan (4th anniversary), murhy and the deceased members of the boylan family. saturday 7th 6.30pm mary ellen & jim mcgowan, their son seamus and grandson john, knockanaher. also, tommy lyons, dernaskeagh and the deceased members of the lyons and keville families. also, kevin cryan, dernaskeagh (28th anniversary) and the deceased members of the cryan family. also, kenneth john beelby, hull, yorkshire, england. our lady of the rosary church culfadda day mass of the feast of all saints. sunday 1st 10.00am fr vincent murphy, also, alice & martin murphy, knockbrack, aclare, co. sligo. day mass of all souls. monday 2nd 10.00am holy souls. sunday 8th 10.00am seamus o’ connor, kiltytigue, 5th anniversary. also, paul judge, new jersey and drumineal. readers. saturday 31st padraic duffy. sunday 1st sharon hunt. saturday 7th james duffy. sunday 8th geraldine hannon. november masses for the holy souls. “it is …. a holy and wholesome thought to pray for the dead”. november envelopes are available in both keash and culfadda churches, please one and fill in the names of your deceased relatives, friends and neighbours especially those who have no one le ft to pray for them, so that they can be remembered in the masses for the holy souls which will be offered during the month of november. keash

cemetery rosaries. the rosary will be recited in templevanny cemetery on sunday november 1st at 12 noon. the rosary will be recited in knockbrack cemetery on sunday november 8th at 12 noon. the rosary will be recited in toomour abbey on sunday november 15th at 12 noon. annual special remembrance masses for the dead. our annual special remembrance masses for the dead will take place on the weekend of the 28th/29th of november at both masses. a member of each family will be invited to come forward to light a candle for their loved ones who have died. the names of those who have died during the past year will be read. if you have relatives or old neighbours who would like to come, please let them know, especially those who have lost a loved one recently. priests of the parish cluster areas. the priests available in the parish cluster areas are fr michael reilly

. culfadda village – nominated by sligo co. council for all-ireland pride of place 2026 we were delighted to be nominated by sligo county council to represent sligo in the all-ireland pride of place final, although we did not win overall, it was a great honour to be asked. a hugh thank you to the presenters and committees from the local area, also, our musicians, dancers and everyone who helped out on the day of the judging. it was a great success and we were delighted with the turn out and support from the area. thanks again to everyone for making it such a memorable day. knockbrack cemetery – update. the donations towards the upkeep and grass cutting of the cemetery amounted to €2,770 this year. the cost for this work amounted to €3,000. the contractor carrying out this work reluctantly charged €3000 this year as his overheads has increased considerably due to the cost of fuel etc. he will not be in a position to continue this work for the coming year unless the necessary funds are available to cover the cost. donations can still be given in to cathal o’gara, anne shepard, sean gallagher or fr gabriel. eastern harps agm. eastern harps gaa club wishes to advise that our agm will take place on thursday, 26th of november at 8:00pm in our clubhouse in keash. collections. offertory collection – september – online €367.47c baskets €3,490.00c donation towards - culfadda church roof €1,000.00c please donate online,
